families.reason: Protected professor actions and student completion require server-side actor authorization.
The same account can have memberships in multiple contracts and must remain tenant-scoped.
HTTP-visible success, errors and provider states must remain safe and truthful.
The browser must act on the currently live pending review through later completion steps.
Review persistence and external delivery status have ordered states that must remain truthful.
No requirement selects a future destination or validity period from competing dates.
Repeated requests must not create multiple pending review authorities.
Repeated manual requests reuse the pending review according to the defined rule.
External provider failure must not roll back an already valid internal review.
Completion, approval and rejection history must remain traceable.
The contract requires real internal boundaries and forbids mocks except at external boundaries.
Canonical product, deployment and validation documentation must describe the actual evidence boundary.
